hourly.note: ts_utc is the candle end_period_ts; price forward-filled for hours with no trades

daily.note: Kalshi daily: volume = sum of hourly candles by UTC date of end_period_ts, close = last close of the day. Attention values are never interpolated.

wikipedia/pageviews_total.note: Rough noise band is 2/sqrt(n). Daily series are autocorrelated, so the effective n is smaller and this band is generous. Timing and association only, not causation.
